gui.drudge.config.title: Drudge Settings
gui.drudge.feature.areaexcavator.confirm: Press enter to confirm, or select a different position.
chat.drudge.tunnelborer.floor_hole: Found a hole in the tunnel's floor but don't have any blocks to fill it with.
chat.drudge.tunnelborer.flooded: The tunnel is flooded, cannot continue.
description.drudge.feature.autotoolswitc: Switches to the best tool in your hotbar for whatever you're about to mine.
description.drudge.feature.breakflow: Removes the pause between blocks, so you can keep mining without stopping.
description.drudge.feature.treefeller: Fells a whole tree from the bottom up.
description.drudge.feature.tunnelborer: Bores a straight tunnel in the direction you're facing.
description.drudge.feature.areaexcavator: Clears out everything between two corners you select.
description.drudge.setting.treefeller.ra: How far Tree Felling will reach to break blocks.
description.drudge.setting.treefeller.fa: How Tree Felling should aim at the blocks it breaks.
description.drudge.setting.treefeller.sw: How Tree Felling should swing your hand when breaking blocks.
description.drudge.setting.autotoolswitc: Uses swords to break leaves, cobwebs, etc.
Uses an empty hand or a non-damageable item when no applicable tool is found.

Prevents tools from being used when their durability reaches the given threshold, so you can repair them before they break.
Can be adjusted from 0 (off) to 100 remaining uses.
After using a tool, automatically switches back to the previously selected slot.
description.drudge.setting.tunnelborer.l:
Automatically stops once the tunnel has reached the given length.

0 = no limit
description.drudge.setting.tunnelborer.p: Places just enough torches to prevent mobs from spawning inside the tunnel.
description.drudge.setting.generic.face_: Only aims on the server side, so you don't see the camera move.
Aims on the client side, so you see the camera move.
description.drudge.setting.generic.swing: Doesn't swing your hand at all.
Swings on the server side, so other players see the animation.
Swings on the client side, so only you see the animation.
